design: Tall graceful adult female custodian with a broad silver-scaled forehead, four distinct natural mandibles and thick black-and-grey tendrils gathered into a high compact bundle. Narrow gold-stitched shoulders, long purple sleeveless vest, asymmetric layered lower robe with two pale inner folds. Presents a small sealed matte teal rectangular reliquary box in both palms slightly forward. Pale warm-grey skin.
